summary.text: Carol Kazeem is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 159, having taken office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kazeem graduated from Ridley High School in 2010 and earned an associate degree from Anthem College.
In the 2023-2024 session, Kazeem was assigned to the Children & Youth, Education, Environmental Resources & Energy, and Local Government committees.
